scope: Public source export, portable paths, preparation and selected-benchmark execution

cpu_validation.environment: Isolated extracted source on Linux, Python 3.12.3
cpu_validation.earlier_local_attempt: Restricted desktop permissions prevented socket/process-group tests; not counted as passed.

verified: 25 benchmark adapters and preparation/registration routes are present; this is coverage, not full real-data acceptance.
Model, judge, dataset, image and result paths are supplied by users through configuration or CLI.
Configuration-relative paths are resolved relative to their JSON files.
Private experiment identifiers and machine-specific retry scripts are excluded from the public export.
Caller CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES identifiers/order are retained; invalid or insufficient allocations fail before launch.
MileBench independent judge requests rotate over all configured endpoints; retries retain the chosen endpoint and successful cache entries are reused.
Core preprocessing and scoring sources are unchanged; neutral protocol identifiers require new compatible contracts rather than permissive reuse.
remaining_limitations: Public run-suite serializes benchmarks but does not automatically start/release/swap main and judge services.
Native GUI recovery is complete-split only, not a per-question interruption journal.
Native GUI backend is an explicit model-family adapter, not an arbitrary multimodal-model backend.
Real GPU/full-dataset integration and third-party redistribution review remain open.
